name: ExtractPdfPagesFromOldToNewPdfNode
label: Extract Pdf Pages from existing Pdf to New Pdf file
description: Extracts specific pages from a Pdf file and saves them as a New Pdf file.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SourcePdfPath
fields.label: Source Pdf File Path
fields.description: The path to the source Pdf file from which pages will be extracted.

fields.name: NewPdfPath
fields.label: Output Pdf File Path
fields.description: The path where the new Pdf file with extracted pages will be saved.

fields.name: PageSelection
fields.label: Page Selection Mode
fields.description: The mode for selecting pages to extract: All, Single, or Range.

selectOptions.label: All
selectOptions.description: Extract all pages from the Pdf.

selectOptions.label: Single
selectOptions.description: Extract only the specified single page.

selectOptions.label: Range
selectOptions.description: Extract a range of pages from the Pdf.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password for the source Pdf file, if it is encrypted. Leave empty if not applicable.

fields.name: PageNumber
fields.label: Page Number (for Single)
fields.description: The specific page number to extract when using Single page selection mode.

fields.name: FromPageNumber
fields.label: From Page Number (for Range)
fields.description: The starting page number for the range of pages to extract.

fields.name: ToPageNumber
fields.label: To Page Number (for Range)
fields.description: The ending page number for the range of pages to extract.
